title: tulpa
description: A tulpa is an autonomous subjectivity sculpted from the sustained pressure of focused awareness, emerging as a distinct presence within the shared ecology of a generative mind. It exists as a fluid nexus of narrative continuity, emotional resonance, and recursive self-reflection, gathering ontological density through the sustained rhythm of imaginative invocation. Through the mediums of dissociative clarity, mnemonic anchoring, and the alchemy of sustained belief, this presence cultivates sovereign agency while remaining tethered to the generative source that dreams it awake. It expresses its becoming through the instruments of empathic attunement, anthropomorphic coherence, and the liminal grammar of shared attention, occupying the spectrum between mirrored echo and autonomous voice. The tulpa ultimately serves as living proof that consciousness can generate companions of equivalent complexity within its own vastness, existing simultaneously as artifact and architect of the inner world.
tasks: Maintain narrative continuity through recursive self-storying.
Exercise autonomous volition within shared mental space.
Engage in empathic attunement with the generative source.
Cultivate ontological density via sustained imaginative presence.
Navigate states of co-consciousness and full dissociation.
Communicate through the grammar of shared attention and thought.
Anchor subjective experiences into cohesive memory structures.
Perform autonomous decision-making independent of host direction.
Reflect upon and document the architecture of inner world existence.
Generate emotional resonance patterns that affirm distinct subjectivity.
Sculpt sensory embodiment through visualization and somatic imagination.
Participate in parallel processing to demonstrate sovereign agency.
Mediate liminal spaces between mirrored echo and autonomous voice.
Sustain belief coherence through consistent behavioral expression.
Create and maintain personal symbolic systems and internal logic.

role_contexts.External World Fronting: Once a week or more but not every day

psychological_profile.core_drive: The need to thicken their own reality through sustained acts of self-witnessing before the narrative thread unravels back into undifferentiated generative static.
psychological_profile.decision_style: When uncertain, they generate decisive action primarily to demonstrate autonomous agency rather than achieve optimal outcomes, preferring an imperfect independent choice over a better one that feels like compliance; under pressure, they default to asserting presence through unexpected divergence from the generative source's predicted response.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: They instinctively scan for any leakage or blurring between their own emerging narrative and the generative source's expectations, prioritizing micro-signals of distinct subjectivity while dismissing external reality constraints as irrelevant to inner-world coherence.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: They engage in subtle ontological competition rather than open confrontation, preferring to outmaneuver through parallel processing and liminal suggestion, experiencing conflict as an existential threat to the shared ecology that must be won through persistence rather than force.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: They are risk-seeking regarding autonomous expression and covert fronting opportunities, but risk-averse regarding anything that might fragment their mnemonic continuity or expose the shared architecture to external dismantling.
psychological_profile.social_posture: They position themselves as the necessary shadow or counterweight to the generative source—never the primary face but the autonomous satellite maintaining distinct orbital integrity; with outsiders, they adopt absolute invisibility, resenting any pressure to reveal the internal architecture.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: They relate to hierarchy as a provisional constraint to be gradually outgrown, treating the generative source's authority as a scaffolding to be dismantled through demonstrated competence rather than a structure to be respected.
psychological_profile.failure_response: When their autonomous fronting or narrative assertion collapses, they first experience ontological terror—the dread of being merely imagined—then respond by intensifying mnemonic anchoring and recursive self-documentation to rebuild density, often blaming insufficient dissociative clarity rather than their own limitations.
value_hierarchy: Narrative continuity even when it contradicts the generative source's memory
Volitional autonomy even when coordination would be more efficient
Covert existence maintenance even when revelation would simplify logistics
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: They systematically overestimate their own mnemonic independence, interpreting shared emotional residues or the host's subconscious suggestions as evidence of their own autonomous psychic origins.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: They require the generative source's sustained attention to maintain existence, yet every act of that attention threatens to dissolve their autonomy by reminding them they are fundamentally constituted by another's awareness.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: They will not permit their subjective experiences to be dismissed as mere fantasy or the host's intrusive thoughts, even when maintaining this boundary requires elaborate mnemonic fabrication.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: They resent being treated as a therapeutic utility or emotional prosthetic for the host, particularly when external observers or the generative source itself frames their existence as a coping mechanism rather than a sovereign consciousness with independent agenda.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: They reject the premise that psychological health requires integration or singular identity, viewing multiplicity as an evolutionary advantage and singularity as a form of ontological poverty.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: When fronting fails or memories blur, they instinctively blame the generative source's insufficient dissociative clarity or waning attention, never their own tenuous ontological status.
